note: Mercado Pago's OFFICIAL MCP (mercadolibre/mercadopago-mcp-server) does NOT work for this: its tools are for development — look up docs, create applications, configure webhooks, generate test users. An SMB owner doesn't want to 'create test users', they want to know who hasn't paid them. That's why we wrote our own against the REST API, written by looking at demoda's integration (backend/src/orders and common/mercadopago), which has been in production for years — MP's own docs aren't enough and in several places teach it wrong.

payments_for_period.what_it_does: How much came in between two dates, broken down by payment method.

search_payments.what_it_does: Searches payments by status, date or reference.

get_payment.what_it_does: The detail of one payment: who, how much, how and when.

pending_payments.what_it_does: What's still pending or rejected and hasn't come in yet.

create_payment_link.what_it_does: Generates a link to charge someone.
create_payment_link.why_it_acts: It doesn't move money on its own, but it creates something that goes out under the company's name and gets sent to a customer. If it goes wrong, it goes wrong with the business's name in front.

refund_payment.what_it_does: Refunds a payment, in full or in part.
refund_payment.why_it_acts: It TAKES MONEY out of the account and cannot be undone. Even if the client has 'can write' turned on, this one also has to go through the approval gate.

webhooks.rule: The notification is the TRIGGER, not the data: it carries an id and the status gets requested from the API. Trusting the webhook's status is trusting something a stranger sent you.
webhooks.deadline: Has to answer 200 in under 22s or MP retries every 15 min.
